name: Poslednij Put'
source:
He has no strength left to fight. Expulsion from the university, breaking up with his girlfriend Rei, the constant reproach from parents - day in and day out, he has to go through a string of problems with no end in sight. The only thing that keeps him going are his childhood memories of Hima, his first love. As the last resort, they wanted to drop everything and run away from their parents, school and friends. But that was not destined to happen.

However, fate gives him a second chance. Thanks to two demonesses who look like two drops like Hima and Rei, he once again gets in the most important moments of his life. Will it change anything? Or will it lead him to the end?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
他已经没有力气去战斗了。被大学开除、与女友丽分手、父母不断的责备……日复一日，他要面对一连串看不到尽头的问题。唯一让他继续前进的就是他对初恋希玛的童年记忆。作为最后的手段，他们想放弃一切，逃离父母、学校和朋友。但这并不是注定会发生的。

然而，命运给了他第二次机会。感谢希玛和丽这两个看起来像两滴水滴的魔女，他再次迎来了人生中最重要的时刻。它会改变什么吗？或者这会引导他走向结局吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535810/]Steam[/url]]
